interface.shortDescription: Engineering skills and orchestration loops for Codex
interface.longDescription: Forge gives Codex a disciplined software-engineering toolkit: orchestration, task ledgers, solve loops, code review, testing, debugging, security, architecture, documentation, and release workflow skills. It is the Codex-compatible side of the Forge toolkit; Claude Code also gets agents, slash commands, and hooks from the same repo.
